arguments.sql: SELECT m.mcc AS mcc, c.description AS description, COUNT(t.id) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN merchants m ON t.merchant_id = m.id JOIN mcc_codes c ON m.mcc = c.mcc WHERE c.description = 'Passenger Railways' GROUP BY m.mcc, c.description ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, m.mcc
arguments.explanation: Counts transactions for each MCC code described as 'Passenger Railways'.
assumptions: Matched the description exactly as 'Passenger Railways' (case-sensitive), per the schema.
Counted all transactions regardless of whether they carry a fraud label or an error.
